name: Demon's Deal
source:
It is a season of joy, entertainment and fun! People have set up stalls, celebrating a festival in this beautiful town. However, not everyone has such light hearted intentions in this jolly day…

Ater, a great demon from the realm below, visits the mortal realm, with the intention of enslaving humans, striking deals with them that’ll bind their souls to him, for all of eternity. With evil intentions, he goes to stall by stall, trying to enforce his wicked goal on the many innocent… which is when, he stumbled upon a weird igloo, that apparently, is also a stall that participates in this winter festival… but will he succeed in striking a deal with the odd looking lady, Aurora? Or will things take a more unpredictable direction? 

[From [url=https://denniyopi.itch.io/demons-deal]itch.io[/url]]
